messages:
sara: Quick sync — propose we run an eviction simulation to validate graceful degradation for Dedicated. Goal is to define concrete launch gates for 'graceful eviction' (latency, errors, fairness) and verify ops playbooks.

mike: SGTM. what inputs are we running? prod traces? synthetic spikes?

sara: Mix: 60% short chat, 30% completions, 10% embeddings. Use recent prod traces + synthetic surge shapes (step, ramp, flash). Link to draft plan: https://go/redwood/dedicated/eviction-sim 

alok: +1. also measure KV-cache hit rate decay and session continuity (session affinity loss). Add metrics: "cold-start extra latency" and per-tenant tail drop.

jen: timeline? do we have infra budget to run wide parameter sweep? :money_with_wings:

sara: Plan: run parameter sweep this week, aggregate results Thu, gating call Fri. Owners: mike = sims, alok = metrics/dashboard, jen = launch gating doc.

mike: I'll start. rough command I'm using: 
```bash
./evict-sim --traces s3://prod/traces/2025Q1 --preempt-rates 0,10,30,50 --surge-patterns step,ramp,flash --duration 30m --out results/evict-$(date +%s).json
```

ops-bot: simulation infra quota approved (req-456) — you can spawn up to 50 parallel workers.

dan: For canary, propose two-phase rollout: 5% low-criticality tenants -> 25% cross-section -> full. Tie each phase to automated KPI checks for 15m window.

sara: Draft launch gates (initial):
- p99 latency (overall) <= 250ms during a 30% preempt window
- user-visible error rate <= 0.5%
- per-tenant throughput reduction 95th <= 10% (fairness)
- KV-cache hit rate drop <= 20% vs baseline
- no regressions on quality evals for representative prompts
- ops playbook validated (eviction runbook + rollback path)

jen: Add billing correctness validation during preemptions (no double-charging, sessions billed to correct pool).

mike: Noted. Any customer-blockers? Acme asked for p50 below 100ms during soft-eviction windows in their contract.

sara: We'll map customer SLA overrides to per-tenant reserved pools; for GA launch require meeting default baseline gates only. Contracts like Acme will be handled via dedicated commits.

alok: I'll build a dashboard with these KPIs and wire alerts (ETA Wed). Also will include a fairness heatmap per tenant.

sara: Action items: mike run sims (ETA Thu), alok dashboard (ETA Wed), jen rollout doc + billing tests (ETA Fri), dan canary plan (ETA Mon). Ping me if blocked. :raised_hands:

mike: starting sims now, will post progress and raw result links in this thread.

jen: putting a stub for the gating doc here: https://go/redwood/dedicated/eviction-gates (will populate)

ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window 2025-04-02 02:00 UTC — avoid heavy sims during that window.

sara: thanks all — we'll use the Fri sync to decide whether these gates are acceptable for the GA checklist. If sims show a single failing bucket, we'll document mitigation and required follow-ups.
